  "correct_approach": "Maintain strict fidelity to the provided tool schema: use 'guitar_price.find' with exact namespace notation, and ensure all three user requests map to their corresponding tools—identify_color_rgb, guitar_price.find, and board_game.chess.get_top_players—all invoked in parallel with appropriate parameters extracted from the user query.",

}
